n6df07292ac.headline: Dubai court ruling prohibits Islamic banks from charging late payment interest
n6df07292ac.summary: A Dubai court ruling prohibits Islamic banks from charging late payment interest. The ruling differs from a 1990s Federal Supreme Court decision that allowed legal interest as compensation for delays.
n6df07292ac.why: Islamic banks in the UAE operate under Sharia-compliant principles, so rules on late-payment charges affect their lending income and contract terms.

ndbe851e63b.headline: Military Troops apprehend 62 Suspected Oil Thieves, Confiscate Over 350,000 Litres
ndbe851e63b.summary: Nigeria's 6 Division army has intensified operations against oil theft and pipeline sabotage in the Niger Delta, across Rivers, Bayelsa, Delta and Akwa Ibom states. The campaign recorded arrests and seizures.
ndbe851e63b.why: Nigeria is a major African crude producer, and pipeline theft and illegal refining reduce its legal oil output and export revenue.

na3364dfcb6.headline: Sensex Rebounds On Banking Boost, Nifty Crosses 25,000 Mark After 2-Day Slump
na3364dfcb6.summary: The Sensex jumped 442 points and the Nifty crossed 25,000 after a two-day slump. Gains were led by ICICI Bank and HDFC Bank after their earnings, while Reliance slipped after a record profit.
na3364dfcb6.why: The Sensex and Nifty are the benchmark indexes of the Indian equity market, tracking large listed companies on the BSE and NSE.

n52835a2037.headline: Naira Depreciates Despite Constant CBN intervention
n52835a2037.summary: The naira closed the week weaker, down 0.14% to 1,532.34 per dollar at the Nigerian Foreign Exchange Market. It had rebounded to a four-month high on the first trading day.
n52835a2037.why: The naira is Nigeria's currency, and its exchange rate with the dollar influences import costs, inflation and foreign investor returns.

nce59277a3c.headline: Titan’s Damas buy pushes focus into wider GCC market
nce59277a3c.summary: Titan Holdings has acquired a 67% stake in Damas LLC, expanding its reach in the GCC jewellery market. The deal includes an option to purchase a further stake in future.
nce59277a3c.why: Damas is a jewellery retailer in the Gulf region, so the deal shifts ownership and regional retail reach in a sector with high brand value.

n0a6199cfbe.headline: Ryanair profits more than double on Easter timing and fare hikes
n0a6199cfbe.summary: Ryanair's profits more than doubled, the report says, helped by the timing of Easter and higher fares.
n0a6199cfbe.why: Ryanair is Europe's largest low-cost airline by passengers, and its profitability reflects fare levels and demand across European travel.

nce823f5bc9.headline: Finance Ministry Allows Individual Taxpayers To Claim TDS Refunds By Filing I-T Returns After The Due Date Without Penalty
nce823f5bc9.summary: The Finance Ministry has allowed individual taxpayers to claim TDS refunds by filing income tax returns after the due date without penalty.
nce823f5bc9.why: Tax deducted at source is withheld from income and refunds affect household cash flow, so changes to filing rules matter for taxpayers and tax compliance.

n5e012ceedc.headline: Sensex  rises! These  stocks gained over 10% on BSE
n5e012ceedc.summary: The Sensex rose, with 31 Nifty 50 stocks ending in the green and 19 in the red. Some stocks on the BSE gained more than 10% in the session.
n5e012ceedc.why: The Sensex is the benchmark index of the 30 largest companies listed on the BSE, and it reflects broad sentiment in Indian equities.
n5e012ceedc.why_moved: More Nifty 50 stocks closed higher than lower, with some BSE stocks gaining over 10%, which lifted the index.

n9a3eb20336.headline: Stock market update: Nifty Bank index  advances  1.19%
n9a3eb20336.summary: The Nifty Bank index closed 1.19 per cent higher at 56952.75.
n9a3eb20336.why: The Nifty Bank index tracks the largest listed Indian lenders, which makes it a key gauge of the country's banking sector.

na831b27ee5.headline: Venezuela’s authoritarian government has a new target: economists
na831b27ee5.summary: Venezuela's government under Nicolás Maduro has crushed the opposition, jailed judges and politicians, and arrested US citizens, and now reportedly targets economists.
na831b27ee5.why: Restrictions on economists and independent analysis reduce the availability of reliable economic data, raising uncertainty for investors in Venezuela's debt and currency.

n82e1ff118e.headline: Nearly 3 in 5 UK investors would consider long-term asset funds as government greenlights ISA inclusion
n82e1ff118e.summary: Investment Association research shows 57% of UK investors would consider a Long-Term Asset Fund (LTAF) after the government approved its inclusion in ISAs.
n82e1ff118e.why: ISAs are tax-advantaged savings accounts in the UK, and inclusion of LTAFs could widen the investment options available to retail investors.

n074df08bc3.headline: The Attacks On Kurdish Oil Fields Is All The Negotiating Baghdad Wants To Do
n074df08bc3.summary: Recent targeted attacks on Kurdistan Region of Iraq oil fields have halved its output. Suspicion has fallen on Iran-backed militias.
n074df08bc3.why: Kurdistan's oil fields export crude through Iraq's northern pipeline system, so disruptions there can tighten regional supply and affect Iraq's revenues.

na7961df8db.headline: Nicola Willis to question Fonterra boss about skyrocketing price of butter
na7961df8db.summary: New Zealand Finance Minister Nicola Willis plans to question Fonterra's boss about the sharp rise in butter prices. She is looking at what can be done to lower prices for consumers.
na7961df8db.why: Fonterra is New Zealand's largest dairy exporter and a major global supplier of dairy products, so its pricing affects both domestic consumers and export earnings.

n0f4161e14b.headline: DWP pensions warning as millions of workers risk poverty in retirement
n0f4161e14b.summary: New figures show 45% of working-age adults are not putting anything into their pensions. The Glasgow Times reports a DWP warning about retirement poverty risk.
n0f4161e14b.why: Pension saving levels shape long-term household savings, retirement income and demand for pension and investment products.

n542754ebd3.headline: U.S. coffee drinkers and businesses will pay the price for Trump's Brazil tariffs
n542754ebd3.summary: President Trump plans a 50% tariff on all goods from Brazil, which supplies about 30% of US coffee imports. The threat has alarmed the US coffee industry.
n542754ebd3.why: Brazil is the world's largest coffee producer, so US tariffs on its exports affect coffee prices, importers and roasters.
n542754ebd3.why_moved: The proposed 50% tariff targets goods from Brazil, a source of about 30% of US coffee imports, which raises concerns over supply costs for the coffee industry.

n333e25badf.headline: Stock markets rebound on buying in HDFC Bank, ICICI Bank; Sensex climbs 442.61 pts - OrissaPOST
n333e25badf.summary: The BSE Sensex rose 442.61 points to 82,200.34 and Nifty closed above 25,000. Buying in HDFC Bank and ICICI Bank after their quarterly earnings snapped a two-day fall.
n333e25badf.why: The Sensex tracks 30 large Indian companies, and HDFC Bank and ICICI Bank are among the country's largest lenders, so their results weigh heavily on the index.

source.name: Odisha News, Odisha Latest news, Odisha Daily - OrissaPOST

n64034b6c10.headline: Lawyers for Harvard and Trump square off in court in Boston
n64034b6c10.summary: Lawyers for Harvard and the Trump administration argued before a federal judge in Boston over the legality of canceling more than $2 billion in federal research grants.
n64034b6c10.why: Federal research funding is a major revenue source for leading US universities, affecting their budgets and research programmes.

n39076a4782.headline: Shanghai Healthcare M&A Fund Strategically Acquires Chengdu Kanghua Biological, Establishing a Fully Integrated Ecosystem
n39076a4782.summary: A Shanghai healthcare M&A fund has acquired Chengdu Kanghua Biological Products, according to a newswire release dated 21 July 2025. The deal is described as creating a fully integrated ecosystem.
n39076a4782.why: Healthcare M&A funds consolidate biopharmaceutical businesses, and acquisitions of biological product makers can change competitive positions in China's drug and vaccine markets.

n72cc9270a0.headline: New 20 euro fee to enter Spain, France and Greece
n72cc9270a0.summary: The 20 euro fee must be paid for every eligible traveller in a group. Costs can therefore add up quickly for families and groups.
n72cc9270a0.why: Entry fees on visitors can affect tourism volumes and spending, which matter for hotels, airlines and travel companies in the affected countries.

n581cc40795.headline: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent Discusses Current Status of Trade Negotiations
n581cc40795.summary: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said baseline and reciprocal tariffs are about 10 days from taking effect on August 1, 2025. He described the EU deal as the most difficult to make.
n581cc40795.why: The Treasury Secretary leads US economic and trade policy, and tariff rates directly affect import costs, trade flows and corporate margins.

n8aae5c3810.headline: Unemployment to remain low, challenges expected
n8aae5c3810.summary: Malaysia's unemployment rate is expected to average below 3% this year, supported by higher employment and steady job opportunities, particularly in services.
n8aae5c3810.why: Labour market strength shapes household spending and consumption, which drive much of Malaysia's economic growth.

n842e37bf91.headline: Japan's shaky government loses upper house control
n842e37bf91.summary: Japan's government lost control of the upper house, while the prime minister also lost the more powerful lower house in October. The ballot does not directly decide whether the administration falls.
n842e37bf91.why: Japan is the world's fourth-largest economy, and political instability can affect fiscal policy, the yen and Japanese equities.

na8f6dd03ef.headline: Gold steady as investors await US trade updates, central bank meetings
na8f6dd03ef.summary: Gold prices were little changed on Monday as investors monitored US trade talks and awaited the Federal Reserve's upcoming policy meeting.
na8f6dd03ef.why: Gold is a traditional store of value, and its price often reacts to interest rate expectations and trade uncertainty.

needd7d2fc8.headline: China pledged more to Philippines than any SEA country but spent the least
needd7d2fc8.summary: China pledged $30 billion in aid to the Philippines since 2015 but delivered just $700 million, according to a new report. Most projects were delayed, dropped or rerouted to other funders.
needd7d2fc8.why: Infrastructure aid and investment pledges shape bilateral economic ties and the pipeline of projects for construction and engineering firms.

neb9d1a69b3.headline: Climate crisis causing food price spikes around the world, scientists say
neb9d1a69b3.summary: A scientific report finds extreme climate events are linked to price hikes for rice, corn, cocoa, coffee, potatoes and other food items.
neb9d1a69b3.why: Agricultural commodities such as corn, cocoa and coffee are traded on futures markets, and weather shocks can move their prices sharply.

n2be0f77f68.headline: BWH Hotels, Savers Group to boost Philippine expansion | TTG Asia
n2be0f77f68.summary: BWH Hotels has signed a strategic agreement with Savers Group Holdings to accelerate growth of its hotel and resort portfolio in the Philippines. The deal aims to expand hotel and resort capacity in the country.
n2be0f77f68.why: BWH Hotels is a global hotel franchising group, and partnerships like this expand its brand presence in fast-growing tourism markets.

n593edd0f2d.headline: Asia shares, yen look past Japan politics as earnings loom
n593edd0f2d.summary: Asian shares and the yen are looking past Japan's political uncertainty as Wall Street braces for tech earnings. Investors hope for progress in trade talks ahead of the August 1 Trump tariff deadline.
n593edd0f2d.why: The Nikkei 225 is Japan's benchmark stock index, and the yen's value affects Japanese exporters and imports. Trade deadlines and tech earnings influence regional risk sentiment.
n593edd0f2d.why_moved: Investors are weighing Japan's political situation against progress in US trade talks before an August 1 tariff deadline. Earnings from large technology firms in the US are also shaping sentiment.

n2aea02b0cd.headline: Germany and US near final agreement on Patriot systems for Ukraine – Bloomberg
n2aea02b0cd.summary: Germany and the United States are working out final details of a deal to supply Patriot air defence systems to Ukraine, according to Bloomberg citing sources. The agreement is near completion.
n2aea02b0cd.why: Patriot is a US-made missile defence system produced by RTX, and arms transfers affect defence industry contracts and European security spending. Such deals are often coordinated between governments.

n44680d6b36.headline: Japan PM vows to stay on after bruising election defeat
n44680d6b36.summary: Prime Minister Ishiba says he will remain in office after a bruising election defeat. He cited a looming tariff deadline with the United States that he says could strain the economy.
n44680d6b36.why: Japan is the world's fourth-largest economy, and its government decisions shape trade negotiations and fiscal policy. Political stability affects investor views on Japanese assets.

nb4039ccae0.headline: InstaPay, PESONet transactions increase by 40% in first 6 months
nb4039ccae0.summary: The value of transactions through InstaPay and PESONet rose 39.5% year on year in the first half, according to Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas data.
nb4039ccae0.why: InstaPay and PESONet are the Philippines' main instant and batch electronic payment systems, run under the central bank, so their volumes track digital payment adoption and economic activity.

n8d0ae1dd76.headline: Knight Frank: Manila remains to be the fourth-cheapest prime office rent in Asia-Pacific in Q2
n8d0ae1dd76.summary: Knight Frank data show Manila ranked fourth most affordable for prime office rent among 23 Asia-Pacific markets in the second quarter.
n8d0ae1dd76.why: Office rents reflect demand from business occupiers and are a key measure of commercial real estate returns for investors.

nd671dae175.headline: High number of informal workers eroding demographic advantage: govt
nd671dae175.summary: An Indonesian government official said the high share of informal workers remains a main barrier to reaping the demographic dividend.
nd671dae175.why: Informal employment limits tax revenue, productivity and social protection coverage, affecting long-term growth in Indonesia's large labor force.

n98c5d05860.headline: Gold starts week with Big Jump, Per Tola Rate rises to Rs361,200 in Pakistan
n98c5d05860.summary: Gold prices in Pakistan opened the third week of July with a Rs3,600 single-day gain, pushing the metal near a record high. The tola rate reached Rs361,200.
n98c5d05860.why: Gold is a traditional store of value and a key benchmark for household savings and jewellery demand in South Asia. Local prices track international bullion prices adjusted for the rupee exchange rate.

na2f737524e.headline: Market access could be focus in next round of trade talks with EU
na2f737524e.summary: The Department of Trade and Industry said market access negotiations with the European Union could start by the next round of talks. The report comes from BusinessWorld.
na2f737524e.why: Trade agreements with the European Union set tariff and market access terms for Philippine exporters. Progress in talks affects trade flows and investment planning.

na91135f8eb.headline: Pakistani Rupee closes at 284.95 after loses ground against US Dollar
na91135f8eb.summary: The Pakistani rupee recorded marginal depreciation against the US dollar in the interbank session, losing 8.72 paisa, or 0.03%, and closing at 284.95.
na91135f8eb.why: The rupee's exchange rate affects import costs, inflation and external debt servicing in Pakistan. The interbank market is where banks trade the currency.

n23305c49a2.headline: Marcos seeks support from semiconductor execs ahead of Trump meeting
n23305c49a2.summary: Philippine President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. is set to meet top executives of US semiconductor companies ahead of his meeting with US President Donald Trump.
n23305c49a2.why: Semiconductor companies make chips used across electronics, autos and data centers, so their investment decisions matter for supply chains. Philippine electronics exports depend heavily on this sector.

n704d452379.headline: PHL eyes P200-B RTB offer in Q3
n704d452379.summary: The government is planning to raise P200 billion from its first retail Treasury bond offering this year, according to the report. The offer is scheduled for the third quarter.
n704d452379.why: Retail Treasury bonds let individual investors buy sovereign debt directly, and their size and pricing shape government borrowing costs.

ne2b21dd2d5.headline: CMEPA seen to boost PERA adoption among Filipinos
ne2b21dd2d5.summary: The Securities and Exchange Commission expects more Filipinos to grow their retirement funds under the Personal Equity Retirement Account framework, according to the report.
ne2b21dd2d5.why: Personal Equity Retirement Accounts are long-term investment vehicles, and their adoption affects domestic capital market depth in the Philippines.

ndc47f308cb.headline: Parent company of Citroën and Fiat suffers a loss of 2.3 billion euros |
ndc47f308cb.summary: Stellantis, the parent company of Citroën and Fiat, reported a loss of 2.3 billion euros. The figure was reported in a July 21, 2025 article.
ndc47f308cb.why: Stellantis is a multinational carmaker formed from Fiat Chrysler and PSA, and its results reflect global auto demand, costs and tariffs.

n50c2feb953.headline: Iran Accuses UK, France, Germany Of Violating 2015 Nuclear Deal
n50c2feb953.summary: Tehran accused Britain, France, and Germany of failing to uphold their commitments under the 2015 Iran nuclear deal following recent threats.
n50c2feb953.why: Nuclear deal tensions affect geopolitical risk and sanctions regimes, influencing energy markets and international relations.

na300b27845.headline: Jio's 5G Users Cross 213 Million In Q1FY26
na300b27845.summary: Jio reported a record 5G subscriber growth in Q1 FY26, reaching 213 million users, driven by IPL-related data demand and increased fixed wireless connections.
na300b27845.why: Jio is India's largest telecom operator, and its rapid 5G adoption reflects growing digital infrastructure and consumer demand, impacting telecom sector growth and technology adoption.

nb53b0b2c43.headline: Union Bank shares slip 4% after Q1 profit rises 12% YoY but NII declines
nb53b0b2c43.summary: Union Bank's total income increased to Rs 31,791 crore in Q1, up from Rs 30,874 crore last year, but net interest income fell 3.2% to Rs 9,112.6 crore.
nb53b0b2c43.why: Union Bank is a major Indian lender; its earnings reflect banking sector health and interest margin trends affecting profitability.
nb53b0b2c43.why_moved: The mixed earnings report with rising profits but falling net interest income influenced investor sentiment on the bank's profitability outlook.

n9a7059b041.headline: PM Suryaghar Scheme: ₹135 Crore Subsidy Distributed In Western Madhya Pradesh For Rooftop Solar Systems
n9a7059b041.summary: Under the PM Suryaghar Scheme, eligible households in Western Madhya Pradesh are receiving subsidies up to Rs 78,000 to install rooftop solar power systems.
n9a7059b041.why: Government subsidies for renewable energy installations promote clean energy adoption and reduce dependence on fossil fuels.

n7f5ffa15d1.headline: Mauritius/China relations: toward new strategic opportunities for collaboration
n7f5ffa15d1.summary: Mauritius's Economic Development Board received China's ambassador to discuss new strategic opportunities for collaboration, with the board's CEO attending the meeting.
n7f5ffa15d1.why: Mauritius is an international financial and investment hub, and its bilateral ties with China affect foreign direct investment flows into the island.

n09a29c7bbe.headline: Investment in Roshan Digital Accounts Exceeds $10.5 Billion
n09a29c7bbe.summary: Investment in Pakistan's Roshan Digital Accounts has exceeded $10.5 billion, with a record $2.3 billion inflow in fiscal year 2025. The accounts channel overseas Pakistani remittances and investment.
n09a29c7bbe.why: Roshan Digital Accounts are Pakistan's program for overseas Pakistanis to remit and invest in the country, which supports foreign exchange reserves.

n2d93c831b9.headline: Procedure for state registration of company bankruptcies approved
n2d93c831b9.summary: President Ilham Aliyev signed amendments to the Tax Code and the law on state registration of legal entities. The changes set a procedure for registering company bankruptcies.
n2d93c831b9.why: Bankruptcy and corporate registration rules shape creditor recovery and business risk for investors in the Azerbaijani economy.

n0fde4ea5fc.headline: China's photovoltaic industry chain fully goes overseas; sustainability issues come onto the agenda
n0fde4ea5fc.summary: Trina Solar's head said Chinese photovoltaic companies building factories abroad show the industry moving from 'made in China, sold worldwide' to 'made worldwide, sold worldwide'. Sustainability was also raised.
n0fde4ea5fc.why: Trina Solar is a major Chinese solar module maker, and overseas plants affect global solar supply chains, trade exposure and costs.
